title: Springfield Ballet’s The Nutcracker
seo_title: Springfield Ballet's The Nutcracker at The Landers Theatre
description: Springfield Ballet's The Nutcracker is a holiday ballet performance produced by Springfield Ballet, Inc., with performances running December 17–21, 2026. It runs about 2 hours, including one 20-minute intermission, and is rated G. It takes place at The Landers Theatre, 311 E. Walnut Street in Springfield, MO, on December 17, 2026, Time TBD, with tickets sold only through Springfield Little Theatre.
